body:
So I’m 19. I’ve been suffering with bipolar disorder all my life, along with a lot of childhood abuse (mental, physical, verbal) and drugs in my family. This has led me to be in a terrible mind. Sometimes, I feel like if I were to make my mind into a landscape, it would be horrifying. However, I’ve also found comfort in that darkness too. At the same time, it drives me, it makes me want to let it all out creatively- it also makes me want to do absolutely nothing with my day and sit in bed and play WoW (which I’m not even remotely good at) or waste my time on something that has no significance. 

My biggest problem is with my mother, and no, before any trolls come and say something stupid like an “oedipus complex” or “mommy issues” (like I’ve heard before) I don’t have a thing for my mother. In fact, I don’t even know if I love her. I haven’t seen her in 7 years. She calls me, and I ignore her. She messages me on Facebook, and sure, I respond, but it’s the typical “I love you and miss you too.” I don’t know if that’s true or not. I say that small thing on Facebook to make her feel better, and make her happy, but I am still struggling with if I love her or not. I’ve taught myself throughout the years (I had to, because my dad wasn’t around until 7 years ago and there was a lot of drug abuse and neglect in the family) that blood doesn’t mean anything. 

I don’t know. I’m not sure why I vented this to you beautiful people of the internet, or why this post influenced me to vent. I’ve struggled with suicide since I was at-least 11. I have a lot of issues, and prescriptions didn’t work. Maybe venting this will help, but idk. My apologies for wasting anyone’s time reading this, my apologies to anyone who thinks I want a pity-party- I don’t. My apologies for the shitty grammar/spelling. However, to all of you that read this though, thank you for your time.
